sentences.text: 有经济学家研究表明，1973至1982年间滞胀普遍存在于七大市场经济体。
sentences.evidence: Economists have shown that stagflation was prevalent among seven major market economies from 1973 to 1982.

sentences.text: 滞胀带来政策两难：收紧货币政策等抑制通胀的措施可能加剧失业。
sentences.evidence: Stagflation presents a policy dilemma, as measures to curb inflation—such as tightening monetary policy—can exacerbate unemployment

sentences.text: 1970年代的滞胀促使人们重新评估凯恩斯主义政策，并推动了货币主义和供给学派的兴起。
sentences.evidence: The stagflation of the 1970s led to a reevaluation of Keynesian economic policies and contributed to the rise of alternative economic theories, including monetarism and supply-side economics.
